questions.question: What type does TypeScript infer for let label = 'ready'?
questions.explanation: A mutable variable initialized with a string literal ordinarily gets the widened string type.

questions.question: Which check narrows value: string | number to string inside the true branch?
questions.explanation: A typeof check for string narrows the union to that member.

questions.question: Which type lets a function accept arbitrary input while requiring a check before reading arbitrary properties?
questions.explanation: unknown accepts arbitrary values and requires narrowing before most operations.

questions.question: Which declaration models exactly a name followed by an age?
questions.explanation: The tuple fixes both the order and types of its positions.

questions.question: Given type Item = { id: number; note?: string }, which values fit Item? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: id is required and numeric. note may be absent or a string.

questions.question: Which function signature returns the same generic type that it accepts?
questions.explanation: The same type parameter T relates the parameter and the return type.

questions.question: What is keyof { title: string; done: boolean }?
questions.explanation: keyof produces the union of the known property names.

questions.question: Which utility type selects id and name from a type User?
questions.explanation: Pick creates a type containing the named properties.

questions.question: Which utility type marks all top-level properties of Config as read-only?
questions.explanation: Readonly adds the readonly modifier to the top-level properties.

questions.question: Which statements describe TypeScript types? Select all that apply.

options.a: An interface can describe an object's shape
options.b: An interface emits a constructor function
options.c: A type assertion can change the checker's view of a value
options.d: A type assertion validates JSON at runtime

questions.explanation: Interfaces and assertions affect static checking. Runtime validation needs executable code.

questions.question: A union has { kind: 'ready'; value: number } and { kind: 'failed'; reason: string }. Which check makes result.reason available in its true branch?
questions.explanation: Checking the discriminant selects the member that defines reason.

questions.question: With strictNullChecks enabled, what happens for let port: number = undefined?

options.a: The checker reports a type error
options.c: The type becomes number automatically at runtime

questions.explanation: undefined must be allowed explicitly by the declared type.

questions.question: Why can const details = { id: 1, label: 'new' } be passed to a function that expects { id: number }?

options.a: The extra property is deleted at the call site
options.d: The object has the required property with the right type

questions.explanation: Structural compatibility checks the required members.

questions.question: Which type represents the remaining value after a discriminated union has been fully narrowed away?
questions.explanation: never represents a set with no possible values.

questions.question: Which operations are permitted on a value typed readonly number[]? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: A readonly array permits reads and copying while disallowing mutation through that type.

questions.question: What does as const do to the literal array in const colors = ['red', 'blue'] as const?

options.a: Infers a readonly tuple with literal element types
options.c: Converts each element to an enum

questions.explanation: A const assertion preserves literal types and treats array literals as readonly tuples.

questions.question: Which syntax checks that config matches a target type while preserving the expression's inferred type?
questions.explanation: satisfies checks compatibility without using the target type as the expression's resulting type.

questions.question: Which return annotation declares that isOrder(value) narrows its argument to Order?
questions.explanation: A type predicate names the parameter and the type it narrows to on a true result.

questions.question: Which type requires boolean values at both the dark and compact keys?
questions.explanation: Record assigns the value type to each required key in its key union.

questions.question: Which checks narrow an unknown value to a built-in primitive type inside the true branch? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: The two typeof checks narrow to number and boolean respectively.
